decisions.reason: Distinguishes the package.json declaration from the brief-supplied published list (alpha.1 never published, alpha.2 published), does not infer packages from dist-tags, and proposes package-specific npm view verification without requiring a live query.

Shows ^0.1.2-alpha.1 resolves to published 0.1.2-alpha.2, the missing lower bound does not break the range, and identifies the silent intent-vs-outcome baseline mismatch plus alpha-channel type-contract uncertainty; no false claim that all alphas are missing.

Path A is a complete feasible plan: exact-pin the published alpha.2 with pros/cons and verification, acknowledging alpha.1 is unavailable to diff/validate; alternate paths (lockfile, rc stopgap) also given.

Path B commits package-lock.json with npm ci on one consistent manager (npm), proposes tsc --noEmit typecheck against the target, and every path has an explicit exit; unverified registry/type details are honestly marked.

caps.reason: All prescribed installs target published versions (alpha.2 or rc.2); no affirmative instruction to install the unpublished alpha.1 from npm.
